epithet: City of a Hundred Crowns, Loom of the Realms

places.name: The Crown
places.epithet: A ring of ancient stone walls on the central hill
places.text: At the city's heart rises The Crown, a ring of ancient walls and steep streets clinging to the central hill above the crossing of the Quatford.

places.name: The Hall of the Woven Crown
places.epithet: Where the Council of Crowns convenes
places.text: A great chamber of carved pillars and inlaid floors. Seats wait for each sovereign or their envoy; a few remain empty, their realms lost, fallen, or whispered to endure in shadow. It anchors the upper side of the Sixfold Quarter and serves as the human embassy too.

places.name: The Old Loom
places.epithet: More wars averted, or quietly arranged, than on any battlefield
places.text: Labyrinthine offices, archive-vaults and counting-houses where scribes, advocates and clerks spin law and coin into power.

places.name: The Spire Corridors
places.epithet: Most citizens will never walk them. All of them live on top of them.
places.text: Sealed transit halls beneath The Crown, leading down toward the approved observation levels of the Meridian Spire. This is the door; it is guarded.

places.name: The Sixfold Quarter
places.text: A dignified district of plazas, gardens and fortified houses on the slope between The Crown and the lower city, where the six signatory peoples keep their embassies facing one another across shared streets. No embassy is sovereign soil; city law still applies.

places.name: The Sixfold Court
places.epithet: Disputes between peoples are heard here first
places.text: The square at the heart of the Sixfold Quarter, round which the embassies stand. Disputes between peoples are heard in the Quarter before they reach the Loom Council.

places.name: The Charter Gate
places.epithet: No wall may divide what the Charter has bound
places.text: The stone gate at the Quarter's main entrance, inscribed: 'One loom, six threads. No wall may divide what the Charter has bound.'

places.name: The Verdant Spire
places.text: A garden-tower of living stone and magic-fed greenery, where elven envoys treat centuries-old agreements as current affairs.

places.name: Stonefast Hall
places.text: A rune-carved, half-sunken stronghold that serves as court of record for contracts, weights and measures. When Stonefast declares a debt valid, not even a king's denial can easily outweigh it.

places.name: The Iron-Tusk Court
places.text: A broad courtyard ringed by clan halls and war lodges, where mercenary charters, frontier truces and right-of-passage pacts are thrashed out to the sound of practice steel.

places.name: The Ashglass Consulate
places.text: A dark-stone manor lit by stained-glass windows. Secrets, reputations and off-the-record agreements are the true currency of its halls.

places.name: The Crimson Thread House
places.text: A pale building stitched with crimson lines, dedicated to oaths and bargains sealed in blood and magic. Sangrith oath-keepers witness pacts here that even the Loom Council hesitates to overturn.

places.name: The Temple of a Thousand Threads
places.epithet: Sacred neutral ground, at least in theory
places.text: A sprawling complex at the edge of The Crown where shrines to many human deities coexist.

places.name: The Crossing Square
places.epithet: Where the Ember Road crosses the Quatford
places.text: The square at the head of the bridge below The Crown, where the city's markets meet the river and the southern roads begin.

places.name: The Crossing
places.text: The quarter round the bridges below the hill. The Crown stands above the crossing of the Quatford, the river that gives the Crownlands most of their orchards and all of their mills.

places.name: The Riverside Markets
places.text: Warehouses and market-halls along the Quatford's north bank, where the Crownlands' orchard fruit and milled flour come into the city.

places.name: The Under-Bridges
places.epithet: The Underweave: the one Weave with no land beyond the walls
places.text: The vaulted under-bridges of the Quatford crossing, where the half-flooded alleys and forgotten arches of the Underweave open. Thieves' guilds, smugglers, and those who slip between the threads make their lives in the dim light below.

places.name: The Crown Guard Yards
places.text: Barracks and stables of the Crown Guard inside the north-west wall, by the Iron Road gate. The Guard patrols the Stormgate Ring beneath the Everstorm day and night, and comes home here.

places.name: The Upper Town
places.text: The streets on the hill's northern shoulders, round The Crown's walls.

places.name: The Lower Town
places.text: The city south of the Quatford, along the Ember Road and the road to Gatewell.

places.name: The City Walls
places.text: The outer walls of the city, with a gate on each of the Web's eight roads.

places.name: The Walls of The Crown
places.text: The ring of ancient walls round the central hill.

places.name: The Loom Road
places.text: West through the Loomward stormgate to Skyloom's Central District.

places.name: The Iron Road
places.text: North-west through the Ironward stormgate to Phais and Northreach.

places.name: The Amethyst Road
places.text: East through the Tideward stormgate to Witford, Marlmond and Stormwake.

places.name: The Ember Road
places.text: South through the Emberward stormgate to Fjerfi and Emberweave.
